note: The fifth ḥizb, recited on Friday — opening with a long supplication invoking the Names by which every prophet called upon God, then an extended litany of ṣalawāt upon the Prophet ﷺ measured by all that exists. A hadith describing the great reward of this salawāt is included partway through. Closes with the familiar seal.

verses.ar: وَأَسْأَلُكَ اللّٰهُمَّ بِالْأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَيِّدُنَا آدَمُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ ۞ وَبِالأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَيِّدُنَا نُوحٌ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ ۞ وَبِالْأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَيِّدُنَا هُودٌ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ ۞ وَبِالأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَيِّدُنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ ۞ وَبِالأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَيِّدُنَا صَالِحٌ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ ۞ وَبِالأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَيِّدُنَا يُونُسُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ ۞ وَبِالأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَيِّدُنَا أَيُّوبُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ ۞ وَبِالأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَيِّدُنَا يَعْقُوبُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ ۞ وَبِالأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَيِّدُنَا يُوسُفُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ ۞ وَبِالأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَيِّدُنَا مُوسَى عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ ۞ وَبِالأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَيِّدُنَا هَارُونُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ ۞ وَبِالأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَيِّدُنَا شُعَيْبٌ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ ۞ ‖ وَبِالأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَيِّدُنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ ۞ وَبِالأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَيِّدُنَا دَاوُودُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ ۞ وَبِالأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَيِّدُنَا سُلَيْمَانُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ ۞ وَبِالأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَيِّدُنَا زَكَرِيَّا عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ ۞ وَبِالأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَيِّدُنَا يَحْيَى عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ ۞ وَبِالأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَيِّدُنَا أَرْمِيَاءُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ ۞ وَبِالْأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَيِّدُنَا شَعْيَاءُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ ۞ وَبِالأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَيِّدُنَا إِلْيَاسُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ ۞ وَبِالأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَيِّدُنَا الْيَسَعُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ ۞ وَبِالْأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَيِّدُنَا ذُو الْكِفْلِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ ۞ وَبِالأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَيِّدُنَا يُوشَعُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ ۞ وَبِالأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَيِّدُنَا عِيسَى عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ ۞ وَبِالْأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَيِّدُنَا مُحَمَّدٌ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ ‖ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَعَلٰى جَمِيعِ النَّبِيِّينَ وَالْمُرْسَلِينَ ۞ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ نَبِيِّكَ عَدَدَ مَا خَلَقْتَهُ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ تَكُونَ السَّمَاءُ مَبْنِيَّةً، وَالْأَرْضُ مَدْحِيَّةً، وَالْجِبَالُ مُرْسِيَةً، وَالبِحَارُ مُجْرَاةً، وَالْعُيُونُ مُنْفَجِرَةً، وَالْأَنْهَارُ مُنْهَمِرَةً، وَالشَّمْسُ مُضْحِيَةً، وَالْقَمَرُ مُضِيئًا، والْكَوَاكِبُ مُسْتَنِيرَةً، كُنْتَ حَيْثُ كُنْتَ لَا يَعْلَمُ أَحَدٌ حَيْثُ كُنتَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ
verses.tr: Wa as’aluka Allāhumma bil-asmā’i allatī da‘āka bihā sayyidunā Ādamu ‘alayhi as-salām, wa bil-asmā’i allatī da‘āka bihā sayyidunā Nūḥun ‘alayhi as-salām, wa bil-asmā’i allatī da‘āka bihā sayyidunā Hūdun ‘alayhi as-salām, wa bil-asmā’i allatī da‘āka bihā sayyidunā Ibrāhīmu ‘alayhi as-salām, wa bil-asmā’i allatī da‘āka bihā sayyidunā Ṣāliḥun ‘alayhi as-salām, wa bil-asmā’i allatī da‘āka bihā sayyidunā Yūnus ‘alayhi as-salām, wa bil-asmā’i allatī da‘āka bihā sayyidunā Ayyūb ‘alayhi as-salām, wa bil-asmā’i allatī da‘āka bihā sayyidunā Ya‘qūb ‘alayhi as-salām, wa bil-asmā’i allatī da‘āka bihā sayyidunā Yūsuf ‘alayhi as-salām, wa bil-asmā’i allatī da‘āka bihā sayyidunā Mūsā ‘alayhi as-salām, wa bil-asmā’i allatī da‘āka bihā sayyidunā Hārūn ‘alayhi as-salām, wa bil-asmā’i allatī da‘āka bihā sayyidunā Shu‘ayb ‘alayhi as-salām, wa bil-asmā’i allatī da‘āka bihā sayyidunā Ismā‘īl ‘alayhi as-salām, wa bil-asmā’i allatī da‘āka bihā sayyidunā Dāwūd ‘alayhi as-salām, wa bil-asmā’i allatī da‘āka bihā sayyidunā Sulaymān ‘alayhi as-salām, wa bil-asmā’i allatī da‘āka bihā sayyidunā Zakariyyā ‘alayhi as-salām, wa bil-asmā’i allatī da‘āka bihā sayyidunā Yaḥyā ‘alayhi as-salām, wa bil-asmā’i allatī da‘āka bihā sayyidunā Armiyā’ ‘alayhi as-salām, wa bil-asmā’i allatī da‘āka bihā sayyidunā Sha‘yā’ ‘alayhi as-salām, wa bil-asmā’i allatī da‘āka bihā sayyidunā Ilyās ‘alayhi as-salām, wa bil-asmā’i allatī da‘āka bihā sayyidunā al-Yasa‘ ‘alayhi as-salām, wa bil-asmā’i allatī da‘āka bihā sayyidunā Dhū al-Kifl ‘alayhi as-salām, wa bil-asmā’i allatī da‘āka bihā sayyidunā Yūsha‘ ‘alayhi as-salām, wa bil-asmā’i allatī da‘āka bihā sayyidunā ‘Īsā ‘alayhi as-salām, wa bil-asmā’i allatī da‘āka bihā sayyidunā Muḥammadun ṣallā Allāhu ‘alayhi wa sallam wa ‘alā jamī‘i an-nabiyyīna wal-mursalīn: an tuṣalliya ‘alā sayyidinā Muḥammadin nabiyyika ‘adada mā khalaqtahu min qabli an takūna as-samā’u mabniyyah, wal-arḍu madḥiyyah, wal-jibālu mursiyah, wal-biḥāru mujrah, wal-‘uyūnu munfajirah, wal-anhāru munhamirah, wash-shamsu muḍḥiyah, wal-qamaru muḍī’an, wal-kawākibu mustanīrah, kunta ḥaythu kunta lā ya‘lamu aḥadun ḥaythu kunta illā anta waḥdaka lā sharīka laka.
verses.en: And I ask You, Allah, in the name in which our master Adam, peace be upon him, called You. And I ask You, Allah, in the name in which our master Noah (Nuh), peace be upon him, called You. And I ask You, Allah, in the name in which our master Hud, peace be upon him, called You. And I ask You, Allah, in the name in which our master Abraham (Ibrahim), peace be upon him, called You. And I ask You, Allah, in the name in which our master Salih, peace be upon him, called You. And I ask You, Allah, in the name in which our master Jonah (Yunus), peace be upon him, called You. And I ask You, Allah, in the name in which our master Job (Ayyub), peace be upon him, called You. And I ask You, Allah, in the name in which our master Jacob (Yaqub), peace be upon him, called You. And I ask You, Allah, in the name in which our master Joseph (Yusuf), peace be upon him, called You. And I ask You, Allah, in the name in which our master Moses (Musa), peace be upon him, called You. And I ask You, Allah, in the name in which our master Aaron (Harun), peace be upon him, called You. And I ask You, Allah, in the name in which our master Shuyab, peace be upon him, called You And I ask You, Allah, in the name in which our master Ismael, peace be upon him, called You. And I ask You, Allah, in the name in which our master David (Dawud), peace be upon him, called You. And I ask You, Allah, in the name in which our master Soloman (Sulayman), peace be upon him, called You. And I ask You, Allah, in the name in which our master Zacharaia (Zakariyya), peace be upon him, called You. And I ask You, Allah, in the name in which our master John (Yahya), peace be upon him, called You. And I ask You, Allah, in the name in which our master Jeremian (Armiya), peace be upon him, called You. And I ask You, Allah, in the name in which our master Shaiya (Sha'ya), peace be upon him, called You. And I ask You, Allah, in the name in which our master Elias (Ilyas), peace be upon him, called You. And I ask You, Allah, in the name in which our master Esau (Al Yasa), peace be upon him, called You. And I ask You, Allah, in the name in which our master Dhul kifl, peace be upon him, called You. And I ask You, Allah, in the name in which our master Joshua (Yusha), peace be upon him, called You. And I ask You, Allah, in the name in which our master Jesus, peace be upon him, called You. And I ask You, Allah, in the name in which our master Muhammad the blessings and peace be upon him and all the Prophets and Messengers, called You. That You bless our master Muhammad, Your Prophet, in all that You created before the sky was built, the earth was spread out, the mountains were made stable, the seas began their flow, the springs burst forth, the rivers streamed out, the sun shone forth, the moon beamed and the planets were lit up and there where You were, You were, and and no one know where You were except You alone, O You who have no partner.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ حِلْمِكَ ۞ وَصَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ عِلْمِكَ ۞ وَصَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ كَلِمَاتِكَ ۞ وَصَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ نِعْمَتِكَ ۞ وَصَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ مِلْءَ سَمَاوَاتِكَ ۞ وَصَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ مِلْءَ أَرْضِكَ ۞ وَصَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ مِلْءَ عَرْشِكَ ۞ وَصَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ زِنَةَ عَرْشِكَ ۞ وَصَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا جَرَى بِهِ الْقَلَمُ فِي ‖ أُمِّ الْكِتَابِ ۞ وَصَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا خَلَقْتَ فِي سَبْعِ سَمَاوَاتِكَ ۞ وَصَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا أَنْتَ خَالِقٌ فِيهِنَّ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ‘alā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ‘adada ḥilmik, wa ṣalli ‘alā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ‘adada ‘ilmik, wa ṣalli ‘alā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ‘adada kalimātik, wa ṣalli ‘alā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ‘adada ni‘matik, wa ṣalli ‘alā sayyidinā Muḥammadin mil’a samāwātik, wa ṣalli ‘alā sayyidinā Muḥammadin mil’a arḍik, wa ṣalli ‘alā sayyidinā Muḥammadin mil’a ‘arshik, wa ṣalli ‘alā sayyidinā Muḥammadin zinata ‘arshik, wa ṣalli ‘alā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ‘adada mā jarā bihi al-qalamu fī ummi al-kitāb, wa ṣalli ‘alā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ‘adada mā khalaqta fī sab‘i samāwātik, wa ṣalli ‘alā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ‘adada mā anta khāliqun fīhinna ilā yawmi al-qiyāmah fī kulli yawmin alfa marrah.
verses.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad to the extent of Your forbearance. O Allah, bless our master Muhammad to the extent of Your knowledge. O Allah, bless our master Muhammad as many times as Your words. O Allah, bless our master Muhammad to the extent of Your favour. O Allah, bless our master Muhammad to the fullness of Your skies. O Allah, bless our master Muhammad to the fullness of Your earth. O Allah, bless our master Muhammad to the fullness of Your Throne. O Allah, bless our master Muhammad in the decoration of Your throne. O Allah, bless our master Muhammad in all that the Pen has written in the Mother of the Book. And bless our master Muhammad as much as You have created in Your Seven Heavens. O Allah, bless our master Muhammad as much as You will create in them until the Day of Resurrection and every day a thousand times.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ كُلِّ قَطْرَةٍ قَطَرَتْ مِنْ سَمَاوَاتِكَ إِلَى أَرْضِكَ، مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ‘alā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ‘adada kulli qaṭratin qaṭarat min samāwātika ilā arḍik, min yawmi khalaqta ad-dunyā ilā yawmi al-qiyāmah fī kulli yawmin alfa marrah.
verses.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad in every drop of rain that has fallen from Your skies to Your earth from the day You created the world to the Day of Resurrection and every day a thousand times.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَنْ يُسَبِّحُكَ وَيُهَلِّلُكَ وَيُكَبِّرُكَ وَيُعَظِّمُكَ، مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ‘alā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ‘adada man yusabbiḥuka wa yuhalliluka wa yukabbiruka wa yu‘aẓẓimuka, min yawmi khalaqta ad-dunyā ilā yawmi al-qiyāmah fī kulli yawmin alfa marrah.
verses.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad as many times as those who have glorified You, declared Your unity, magnified You and extolled You from the day You created the world to the Day of Resurrection and every day a thousand times.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ أَنْفَاسِهِمْ وَأَلْفَاظِهِمْ ۞ وَصَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ كُلِّ نَسَمَةٍ خَلَقْتَهَا فِيهِمْ، مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ‘alā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ‘adada anfāsihim wa alfāẓihim, wa ṣalli ‘alā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ‘adada kulli nasamatin khalaqtahā fīhim, min yawmi khalaqta ad-dunyā ilā yawmi al-qiyāmah fī kulli yawmin alfa marrah.
verses.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad in every one of their outbreathing and their utterances. O Allah, bless our master Muhammad in every one of their fragrant outbreathings from the day You created the world to the Day of Resurrection and every day a thousand times.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ السَّحَابِ الْجَارِيَةِ ۞ وَصَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ الرِّيَاحِ الذَّارِيَةِ، مِنْ يَوْمِ ‖ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ‘alā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ‘adada as-saḥābi al-jāriyah, wa ṣalli ‘alā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ‘adada ar-riyāḥi adh-dhāriyah, min yawmi khalaqta ad-dunyā ilā yawmi al-qiyāmah fī kulli yawmin alfa marrah.
verses.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad in every rolling cloud and bless our master Muhammad in every sweeping wind from the day You created the world to the Day of Resurrection and every day a thousand times.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا هَبَّتْ عَلَيْهِ الرِّيَاحُ وَحَرَّكَتْهُ مِنَ الْأَغْصَانِ وَالْأَشْجَارِ، وَالْأَوْرَاقِ وَالثَّمَارِ، وَجَمِيعِ مَا خَلَقْتَ عَلٰى أَرْضِكَ، وَمَا بَيْنَ سَمَاوَاتِكَ، مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ‘alā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ‘adada mā habbat ‘alayhi ar-riyāḥu wa ḥarrakat-hu mina al-aghṣāni wal-ashjār, wal-awrāqi wath-thimār, wa jamī‘i mā khalaqta ‘alā arḍik wa mā bayna samāwātik, min yawmi khalaqta ad-dunyā ilā yawmi al-qiyāmah fī kulli yawmin alfa marrah.
verses.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad in the movement of every branch, every tree, every leaf and every fruit stirred by the wind and in every wind-stirred movement of all else that You have created on Your earth and what is between Your Heavens from the day You have created the world to the Day of Resurrection and every day a thousand times.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ نُجُومِ السَّمَاءِ، مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ‘alā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ‘adada nujūmi as-samā’, min yawmi khalaqta ad-dunyā ilā yawmi al-qiyāmah fī kulli yawmin alfa marrah.
verses.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad in every star in the sky from the day You created the world to the Day of Resurrection and every day a thousand times.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ مِلْءَ أَرْضِكَ، مِمَّا حَمَلَتْ وَأَقَلَّتْ مِنْ قُدْرَتِكَ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ‘alā sayyidinā Muḥammadin mil’a arḍik, mimmā ḥamalat wa aqallat min qudratik.
verses.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad as much as the entire earth and what it holds and what it bears of Your Power.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا خَلَقْتَ فِي سَبْعِ بِحَارِكَ، مِمَّا لَا يَعْلَمُ عِلْمَهُ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، وَمَا أَنْتَ خَالِقُهُ فِيهَا إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ‘alā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ‘adada mā khalaqta fī sab‘i biḥārik, mimmā lā ya‘lamu ‘ilmahu illā anta, wa mā anta khāliquhu fīhā ilā yawmi al-qiyāmah fī kulli yawmin alfa marrah.
verses.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad in everything You have created in the seven seas knowledge of which is Yours alone and in everything You will create in them until the Day of Resurrection and every day a thousand times.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مِلْءِ سَبْعِ بِحَارِكَ ۞ وَصَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ زِنَةَ سَبْعِ ‖ بِحَارِكَ، مِمَّا حَمَلَتْ وَأَقَلَّتْ مِنْ قُدْرَتِكَ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ‘alā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ‘adada mil’i sab‘i biḥārik, wa ṣalli ‘alā sayyidinā Muḥammadin zinata sab‘i biḥārik, mimmā ḥamalat wa aqallat min qudratik.
verses.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad to the fullness of Your Seven Seas. O Allah, bless our master Muhammad in the adornment of Your Seven Seas in that which they hold and bear of Your Power.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ وَصَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ أَمْوَاجِ بِحَارِكَ، مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ
verses.tr: Allāhumma wa ṣalli ‘alā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ‘adada amwāji biḥārik, min yawmi khalaqta ad-dunyā ilā yawmi al-qiyāmah fī kulli yawmin alfa marrah.
verses.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad in every wave on Your Seas from the day You created the world to the Day of Resurrection and every day a thousand times.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ وَصَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ الرَّمْلِ وَالْحَصَى فِي مُسْتَقَرِّ الْأَرْضِينَ وَسَهْلِهَا وَجِبَالِهَا، مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ
verses.tr: Allāhumma wa ṣalli ‘alā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ‘adada ar-ramli wal-ḥaṣā fī mustaqarri al-arḍīn wa sahlihā wa jibālihā, min yawmi khalaqta ad-dunyā ilā yawmi al-qiyāmah fī kulli yawmin alfa marrah.
verses.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad in every grain of sand and in every pebble on the solid ground of the earth, the soft ground of the earth and the mountains of the earth from the day You created the world to the Day of Resurrection and every day a thousand times.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ وَصَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ اِضْطِرَابِ الْمِيَاهِ الْعَذْبَةِ وَالْمِلْحَةِ، مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ ۞ وَصَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا خَلَقْتَهُ عَلٰى جَدِيدِ أَرْضِكَ فِي مُسْتَقَرِّ الْأَرْضِينَ شَرْقِهَا وَغَرْبِهَا وَسَهْلِهَا وَجِبَالِهَا وَأَوْدِيَتِهَا وَطَرِيقِهَا وَعَامِرِهَا وَغَامِرِهَا إِلَى سَائِرِ مَا خَلَقْتَهُ عَلَيْهَا وَمَا فِيهَا مِنْ حَصَاةٍ وَمَدَرٍ وَحَجَرٍ مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ ‖ الْقِيَامَةِ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ
verses.tr: Allāhumma wa ṣalli ‘alā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ‘adada iḍṭirābi al-miyāhi al-‘adhbah wal-milḥah, min yawmi khalaqta ad-dunyā ilā yawmi al-qiyāmah fī kulli yawmin alfa marrah, wa ṣalli ‘alā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ‘adada mā khalaqtahu ‘alā jadīdi arḍik fī mustaqarri al-arḍīn sharqihā wa gharbihā wa sahlihā wa jibālihā wa awdiyatihā wa ṭarīqihā wa ‘āmirihā wa ghāmirihā ilā sā’iri mā khalaqtahu ‘alayhā wa mā fīhā min ḥaṣātin wa madarin wa ḥajarin min yawmi khalaqta ad-dunyā ilā yawmi al-qiyāmah fī kulli yawmin alfa marrah.
verses.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad in the turbulence existing between salt water and fresh water from the day You created the world to the Day of Resurrection and every day a thousand times. And bless our master Muhammad in everything which You have created on the face of Your earth on solid land, in the West and in the East, on soft ground and the mountains, in the streets and the ways, in populated areas and in waste lands, and in what You have created on it and in it elsewhere in every pebble, in every lump of mud and in every stone, from the day You created the world to the Day of Resurrection and every day a thousand times.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ النَّبِيِّ عَدَدَ نَبَاتِ الْأَرْضِ مِنْ قِبْلَتِهَا وَشَرْقِهَا وَغَرْبِهَا، وَسَهْلِهَا وَجِبَالِهَا وَأَوْدِيَتِهَا، وَأَشْجَارِهَا وَثِمَارِهَا، وَأَوْرَاقِهَا وَزُرُوعِهَا، وَجَمِيعِ مَا يَخْرُجُ مِنْ نَبَاتِهَا وَبَرَكَاتِهَا، مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ‘alā sayyidinā Muḥammadin an-nabiyyi ‘adada nabāti al-arḍ min qiblatihā wa sharqihā wa gharbihā, wa sahlihā wa jibālihā wa awdiyatihā, wa ashjārihā wa thimārihā, wa awrāqihā wa zurū‘ihā, wa jamī‘i mā yakhruju min nabātihā wa barakātihā, min yawmi khalaqta ad-dunyā ilā yawmi al-qiyāmah fī kulli yawmin alfa marrah.
verses.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad, the Prophet, in every plant on the earth in the direction of the East the West, on soft ground, on mountains and in the valleys, and may there be blessings in every tree, in every fruit, in every leaf, in every plant, and in any other vegetation or verdure that grows from the day You created the world to the Day of Resurrection and every day a thousand times.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ وَصَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا خَلَقْتَ مِنَ الْجِنِّ وَالْإِنْسِ وَالشَّيَاطِينِ، وَمَا أَنْتَ خَالِقُهُ مِنْهُمْ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ
verses.tr: Allāhumma wa ṣalli ‘alā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ‘adada mā khalaqta mina al-jinni wal-insi wash-shayāṭīn, wa mā anta khāliquhu minhum ilā yawmi al-qiyāmah fī kulli yawmin alfa marrah.
verses.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad in every jinn, human and devil You have created and in every one of them You will create until the Day of Resurrection and every day a thousand times.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ وَصَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ كُلِّ شَعْرَةٍ فِي أَبْدَانِهِمْ وَفِي وُجُوهِهِمْ وَعَلٰى رُءُوسِهِمْ، مُنْذُ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ
verses.tr: Allāhumma wa ṣalli ‘alā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ‘adada kulli sha‘ratin fī abdānihim wa fī wujūhihim wa ‘alā ru’ūsihim, mundhu khalaqta ad-dunyā ilā yawmi al-qiyāmah fī kulli yawmin alfa marrah.
verses.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad in every follicle of hair on their bodies, on their faces, and their heads from the moment You created the world to the Day of Resurrection and every day a thousand times.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ وَصَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ خَفَقَانِ الطَّيْرِ وَطَيْرَانِ الْجِنِّ وَالشَّيَاطِينِ، مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ ‖ مَرَّةٍ
verses.tr: Allāhumma wa ṣalli ‘alā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ‘adada khafaqāni aṭ-ṭayri wa ṭayarāni al-jinni wash-shayāṭīn, min yawmi khalaqta ad-dunyā ilā yawmi al-qiyāmah fī kulli yawmin alfa marrah.
verses.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad in the flapping of birds wings, in the flying of the jinn and devils from the day You created the world to the Day of Resurrection and every day a thousand times.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ وَصَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ كُلِّ بَهِيمَةٍ خَلَقْتَهَا عَلٰى جَدِيدِ أَرْضِكَ مِنْ صَغِيرٍ أَوْ كَبِيرٍ، فِي مَشَارِقِ الْأَرْضِ وَمَغَارِبِهَا، مِنْ إِنْسِهَا وَجِنِّهَا، وَمِمَّا لَا يَعْلَمُ عِلْمَهُ إِلَّا أَنْتَ مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ
verses.tr: Allāhumma wa ṣalli ‘alā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ‘adada kulli bahīmatin khalaqtahā ‘alā jadīdi arḍik min ṣaghīrin aw kabīr, fī mashāriqi al-arḍi wa maghāribihā, min insihā wa jinnihā, wa mimmā lā ya‘lamu ‘ilmahu illā anta min yawmi khalaqta ad-dunyā ilā yawmi al-qiyāmah fī kulli yawmin alfa marrah.
verses.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad in all cattle You have created on the surface of Your earth, both big and small, in the East of the world and in the West, in all the men and the jinn and in all that of which there is no knowledge except Yours from the day You created the world to the Day of Resurrection and every day a thousand times.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ وَصَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ خُطَاهُمْ عَلٰى وَجْهِ الْأَرْضِ مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ
verses.tr: Allāhumma wa ṣalli ‘alā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ‘adada khuṭāhum ‘alā wajhi al-arḍ, min yawmi khalaqta ad-dunyā ilā yawmi al-qiyāmah fī kulli yawmin alfa marrah.
verses.en: O Allah bless our master Muhammad in every ridge on the face of the earth from the day You created the world to the Day of Resurrection and every day a thousand times.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ وَصَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَنْ يُصَلِّي عَلَيْهِ ۞ وَصَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَنْ لَمْ يُصَلِّ عَلَيْهِ ۞ وَصَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ الْقَطْرِ وَالْمَطَرِ وَالنَّبَاتِ ۞ وَصَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ
verses.tr: Allāhumma wa ṣalli ‘alā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ‘adada man yuṣallī ‘alayh, wa ṣalli ‘alā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ‘adada man lam yuṣalli ‘alayh, wa ṣalli ‘alā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ‘adada al-qaṭri wal-maṭar wan-nabāt, wa ṣalli ‘alā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ‘adada kulli shay’.
verses.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad as many times as those who ask for blessings upon him. O Allah, bless our master Muhammad as many times as those who do not ask for blessings upon him. And bless our master Muhammad in every raindrop, in every rainfall and in every plant. And bless our master Muhammad in everything which exists.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ وَصَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ فِي اللَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَى ۞ وَصَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ فِي النَّهَارِ إِذَا تَجَلَّى ۞ وَصَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ فِي الْآخِرَةِ وَالْأُولَى ۞ وَصَلِّ ‖ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ شَابًّا زَكِيًّا ۞ وَصَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَهْلًا مَّرْضِيًّا ۞ وَصَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ مُنْذُ كَانَ فِي الْمَهْدِ صَبِيًّا ۞ وَصَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ حَتَّى لَا يَبْقَى مِنَ الصَّلَاةِ شَيْءٌ
verses.tr: Allāhumma wa ṣalli ‘alā sayyidinā Muḥammadin fī al-layli idhā yaghshā, wa ṣalli ‘alā sayyidinā Muḥammadin fī an-nahāri idhā tajallā, wa ṣalli ‘alā sayyidinā Muḥammadin fī al-ākhirati wal-ūlā, wa ṣalli ‘alā sayyidinā Muḥammadin shābban zakiyyan, wa ṣalli ‘alā sayyidinā Muḥammadin kahlan marḍiyyan, wa ṣalli ‘alā sayyidinā Muḥammadin mundhu kāna fī al-mahdi ṣabiyyan, wa ṣalli ‘alā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ḥattā lā yabqā mina aṣ-ṣalāti shay’.
verses.en: O Allah bless our master Muhammad at night when it grows dark. And bless our master Muhammad in the day when in grows light. And bless our master Muhammad in the end and at the beginning. And bless our master Muhammad in his youth, in his purity. And bless our master Muhammad in his middle-age. And bless our master Muhammad even in the cradle. And bless our master Muhammad until there remains naught from blessings.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ وَأَعْطِ سَيِّدَنَا مُحَمَّدَ نِ الْمَقَامَ الْمَحْمُودَ الَّذِي وَعَدْتَّهُ، الَّذِي إِذَا قَالَ صَدَّقْتَهُ، وَإِذَا سَأَلَ أَعْطَيْتَهُ
verses.tr: Allāhumma wa a‘ṭi sayyidanā Muḥammadan al-maqāma al-maḥmūda alladhī wa‘adtah, alladhī idhā qāla ṣaddaqtah, wa idhā sa’ala a‘ṭaytah.
verses.en: O Allah, grant to our master Muhammad the Most Praised Station which You promised to him, the place where when he speaks, You vindicate him and when he asks, You give him.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ وَأَعْظِمْ بُرْهَانَهُ، وَشَرِّفْ بُنْيَانَهُ، وَأَبْلِجْ حُجَّتَهُ، وَبَيِّنْ فَضِيلَتَهُ
verses.tr: Allāhumma wa a‘ẓim burhānah, wa sharraf bunyānah, wa ablij ḥujjatah, wa bayyin faḍīlatah.
verses.en: O Allah, magnify his proof, honor his edifice, make his argument radiant and clear, and make his virtue evident.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ وَتَقَبَّلْ شَفَاعَتَهُ فِي أُمَّتِهِ، وَاسْتَعْمِلْنَا بِسُنَّتِهِ، وَتَوَفَّنَا عَلٰى مِلَّتِهِ، وَاحْشُرْنَا فِي زُمْرَتِهِ، وَتَحْتَ لِوَائِهِ، وَاجْعَلْنَا مِنْ رُفَقَائِهِ، وَأَوْرِدْنَا حَوْضَهُ، وَاسْقِنَا بِكَأْسِهِ، وَانْفَعْنَا بِمَحَبَّتِهِ، اللّٰهُمَّ آمِينَ
verses.tr: Allāhumma wa taqabbal shafā‘atahu fī ummatih, wast‘amilnā bi sunnatih, wa tawaffanā ‘alā millatih, waḥshurnā fī zumratih, wa taḥta liwā’ih, waj‘alnā min rufaqā’ih, wa awridnā ḥawḍah, wasqinā bika’sih, wanfa‘nā bi maḥabbatih, Allāhumma āmīn.
verses.en: O Allah, accept his intercession for his nation. And establish us on his way, allow us to die in his manner, resurrect us in his company beneath his flag, and make us among his associates, water us at his Pool, allow us to drink from his drinking bowl, and enjoy his love. O Allah Ameen.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ وَأَسْأَلُكَ بِأَسْمَائِكَ الَّتِي دَعَوْتُكَ بِهَا أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا وَصَفْتُ، وَمِمَّا لَا يَعْلَمُ عِلْمَهُ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، وَأَنْ تَرْحَمَنِي وَتَتُوبَ عَلَيَّ وَتُعَافِيَنِي مِنْ جَمِيعِ الْبَلَاءِ وَالْبَلْوَاءِ ‖ وَأَنْ تَغْفِرَ لِي وَتَرْحَمَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ، وَالْمُسْلِمِينَ وَالْمُسْلِمَاتِ الْأَحْيَاءَ مِنْهُمْ وَالْأَمْوَاتَ، وَأَنْ تَغْفِرَ لِعَبْدِكَ (فُلَانِ بْن فُلَانٍ) الْمُذْنِبِ الْخَاطِئ الضَّعِيفِ، وَأَنْ تَتُوبَ عَلَيْهِ، إِنَّكَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمُ ۞ اللّٰهُمَّ آمِينَ، يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ
verses.tr: Allāhumma wa as’aluka bi asmā’ika allatī da‘awtuka bihā an tuṣalliya ‘alā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ‘adada mā waṣaftu, wa mimmā lā ya‘lamu ‘ilmahu illā anta, wa an tarḥamanī wa tatūba ‘alayya wa tu‘āfiyanī min jamī‘i al-balā’i wal-balwā’, wa an taghfira lī wa tarḥama al-mu’minīna wal-mu’mināt, wal-muslimīna wal-muslimāt al-aḥyā’i minhum wal-amwāt, wa an taghfira li ‘abdika (fulān ibn fulān) al-mudhnibi al-khāṭi’i aḍ-ḍa‘īf, wa an tatūba ‘alayh, innaka ghafūrun raḥīm, Allāhumma āmīn, yā Rabb al-‘ālamīn.
verses.en: O Allah and I ask You, in the names in which I have called on You to bless our master Muhammad, as much as I have outlined and as much as that of which You alone have knowledge, to have mercy on me and accept my repentance, absolve me all trials and tribulations, forgive me and my parents and have mercy on the believing men and women, the submitted men and women (i.e. Muslims), the living among them and the dead, and forgive Your servant (so-and-so, son of so-and-so), the sinner, the erroneous one, the weak one, and accept his repentance for You are the Forgiver, the Merciful. O Allah, Amen, O Lord of the worlds.

verses.ar: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللّٰهِ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ :﴿ مَنْ قَرَأَ هٰذِهِ الصَّلَاةَ مَرَّةً وَاحِدَةً كَتَبَ اللّٰهُ لَهُ ثَوَابَ حَجَّةٍ مَقْبُولَةٍ، وَثَوَابَ مَنْ أَعْتَقَ رَقَبَةً مِّنْ وَلَدِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ ﴾، فَيَقُولُ اللّٰهُ تَعَالَى : يَا مَلَائِكَتِي هٰذَا عَبْدٌ مِنْ عِبَادِي أَكْثَرَ الصَّلَاةَ عَلٰى حَبِيبِي مُحَمَّدٍ، فَوَعِزَّتِي وَجَلَالِي وَجُودِي وَمَجْدِي وَارْتِفَاعِي لَأُعْطِيَنَّهُ بِكُلِّ حَرْفٍ صَلَّى قَصْرًا فِي الْجَنَّةِ، وَلَيَأْتِيَنِّي يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ تَحْتَ لِوَاءِ الْحَمْدِ، نُورُ وَجْهِهِ كَالْقَمَرِ لَيْلَةَ الْبَدْرِ، وَكَفُّهُ فِي ‖ كَفِّ حَبِيبِي مُحَمَّدٍ ۞ هٰذَا لِمَنْ قَالَهَا كُلَّ يَوْمِ جُمُعَةٍ، لَهُ هٰذَا الْفَضْلُ، وَاللّٰهُ ذُو الْفَضْلِ الْعَظِيمِ ۞ وَفِي رِوَايَةٍ
verses.tr: Qāla Rasūlullāh ṣallā Allāhu ‘alayhi wa sallam: “Man qara’a hādhihi aṣ-ṣalāta marratan wāḥidatan kataba Allāhu lahu thawāba ḥijjatin maqbūlah, wa thawāba man a‘taqa raqabatan min waladi Ismā‘īl ‘alayhi as-salām.” Fayaqūlu Allāhu ta‘ālā: “Yā malā’ikatī, hādhā ‘abdun min ‘ibādī akthara aṣ-ṣalāta ‘alā ḥabībī Muḥammad, fa bi ‘izzatī wa jalālī wa jūdī wa majdī wartifā‘ī la-u‘ṭiyannahu bi kulli ḥarfin ṣallā qaṣran fī al-jannah, wa laya’tiyannī yawma al-qiyāmah taḥta liwā’ al-ḥamd, nūru wajhih kal-qamari laylata al-badr, wa kaffuh fī kaff ḥabībī Muḥammad.” Hādhā liman qālahā kulla yawmi jumu‘ah, lahu hādhā al-faḍl, wa Allāhu dhū al-faḍl al-‘aẓīm, wa fī riwāyah
verses.en: The Messenger of Allah, Allah’s blessings and peace be upon him. said: “Whoever reads this blessings once, Allah will write for him the reward of an accepted pilgrimage and the reward of freeing a slave from the descendants of Isma’il, peace be upon him. And Allah the Exalted says, ‘O My angels, this is one My slaves who asked for abundant blessings upon My Beloved Muhammad, so through My Power, My Generosity, My Splendour, and My Sublimity, I grant him for every letter of the words asking for blessings a castle in the Garden and I will make him come to me the Day of Resurrection beneath the Flag of Praise, and the light of his face will be like the full moon and he will be hand in hand with My Beloved Muhammad.’” And in another relation.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِحَقِّ مَا حَمَلَ كُرْسِيُّكَ مِنْ عَظَمَتِكَ وَقُدْرَتِكَ وَجَلَالِكَ وَبَهَائِكَ وَسُلْطَانِكَ، وَبِحَقِّ اسْمِكَ الْمَخْزُونِ الْمَكْنُونِ الَّذِي سَمَّيْتَ بِهِ نَفْسَكَ، وَأَنْزَلْتَهُ فِي كِتَابِكَ، وَاسْتَأْثَرْتَ بِهِ فِي عِلْمِ الْغَيْبِ عِنْدَكَ، أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَبْدِكَ وَرَسُولِكَ ۞ وَأَسْأَلُكَ بِاسْمِكَ الَّذِي إِذَا دُعِيتَ بِهِ أَجَبْتَ، وَإِذَا سُئِلْتَ بِهِ أَعْطَيْتَ ۞ وَأَسْأَلُكَ بِاسْمِكَ الَّذِي وَضَعْتَهُ عَلٰى اللَّيْلِ فَأَظْلَمَ، وَعَلٰى النَّهَارِ فَاسْتَنَارَ، وَعَلٰى السَّمَاوَاتِ فَاسْتَقَلَّتْ، وَعَلٰى الْأَرْضِ فَاسْتَقَرَّتْ، وَعَلٰى الْجِبَالِ فَرَسَتْ، وَعَلٰى الصَّعْبَةِ فَذَلَّتْ، وَعَلٰى مَاءِ السَّمَاءِ فَسَكَبَتْ، وَعَلٰى مَاءِ السَّحَابِ ‖ فَأَمْطَرَتْ ۞ وَأَسْأَلُكَ بِمَا سَأَلَكَ بِهِ سَيِّدُنَا مُحَمَّدٌ نَّبِيُّكَ ۞ وَأَسْأَلُكَ بِمَا سَأَلَكَ بِهِ سَيِّدُنَا آدَمُ نَبِيُّكَ ۞ وَأَسْأَلُكَ بِمَا سَأَلَكَ بِهِ أَنْبِيَاؤُكَ وَرُسُلُكَ، وَمَلَائِكَتُكَ الْمُقَرَّبُونَ، صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِمْ أَجْمَعِينَ ۞ وَأَسْأَلُكَ بِمَا سَأَلَكَ بِهِ أَهْلُ طَاعَتِكَ أَجْمَعِينَ ۞ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا خَلَقْتَ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ تَكُونَ السَّمَاءُ مَبْنِيَّةً، وَالأَرْضُ مَدْحِيَّةً، وَالجِبَالُ مُرْسِيَةً، وَالعُيُونُ مُنْفَجِرَةً، وَالْأَنْهَارُ مُنْهَمِرَةً، وَالشَّمْسُ مُضْحِيَةً، وَالْقَمَرُ مُضِيئًا، وَالْكَوَاكِبُ مُنِيرَةً
verses.tr: Allāhumma innī as’aluka bi ḥaqqi mā ḥamala kursiyyuka min ‘aẓamatika wa qudratika wa jalālika wa bahā’ika wa sulṭānik, wa bi ḥaqqi ismika al-makhzūni al-maknūn alladhī sammayta bihi nafsak, wa anzaltahu fī kitābik, wa ista’tharta bihi fī ‘ilmi al-ghaybi ‘indak, an tuṣalliya ‘alā sayyidinā Muḥammadin ‘abdika wa rasūlik. Wa as’aluka bismika alladhī idhā du‘īta bihi ajabta, wa idhā su’ilta bihi a‘ṭayta, wa as’aluka bismika alladhī waḍa‘tahu ‘alā al-layli fa-aẓlama, wa ‘alā an-nahāri fastanāra, wa ‘alā as-samāwāti fastaqqat, wa ‘alā al-arḍi fastaqarat, wa ‘alā al-jibāli farasat, wa ‘alā aṣ-ṣa‘bah fa-dhallat, wa ‘alā mā’i as-samā’i fasakabat, wa ‘alā mā’i as-saḥābi fa-amṭarat, wa as’aluka bimā sa’alaka bihi sayyidunā Muḥammadun nabiyyuk, wa as’aluka bimā sa’alaka bihi sayyidunā Ādamu nabiyyuk, wa as’aluka bimā sa’alaka bihi anbiyā’uka wa rusuluka wa malā’ikatuka al-muqarrabūn, ṣallā Allāhu ‘alayhim ajma‘īn, wa as’aluka bimā sa’alaka bihi ahlu ṭā‘atika ajma‘īn, an tuṣalliya ‘alā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ‘alā āli sayyidinā Muḥammad ‘adada mā khalaqta min qabli an takūna as-samā’u mabniyyah, wal-arḍu madḥiyyah, wal-jibālu mursiyah, wal-‘uyūnu munfajirah, wal-anhāru munhamirah, wash-shamsu muḍḥiyah, wal-qamaru muḍī’an, wal-kawākibu munīrah.
verses.en: O Allah, I ask You for the sake of the truth that carries Your Throne from Your Might Oceans, Your Power Oceans, Your Glory Oceans, Your Splendour Oceans and Your Authority Oceans, and for the sake of the truth of Your name, secret and hidden, which You named Yourself and which You sent down in Your Book and which You alone took for Yourself in the unseen world, that You bless our master Muhammad Your slave and Your Messenger, and I ask You in the name in which were one to call upon You, You would answer, and in which were one to ask You something, You would grant it. And I ask You in Your name which when laid upon the night darkness falls. And when laid upon the day light arises and when laid upon the heavens they are raised up. And when laid upon the earth it becomes solid and firm. And when laid upon the mountains they form summits. And when laid upon difficulties they are overcome. And when laid upon the water of the sky it pours forth. And when laid upon the clouds they rain. And I ask You, for the sake of what our master Muhammad, Your Prophet, asked You for the sake of. And I ask You, for the sake of what our master Adam, Your Prophet, asked You for the sake of. And I ask You, for the sake of what Your Prophets and Your Messengers and Your Closest Angels asked You for the sake of. Allah’s blessings upon them all. And I ask You, for the sake of what all the Folk of Your Obedience asked You for, that You bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad in all that You created before the sky was built, the earth was spread out, the mountains were made stable, the seas began to flow, the springs burst open, the rivers poured forth, the sun shone forth, the moon beamed and the stars were illuminated.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ عِلْمِكَ ۞ وَصَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ حِلْمِكَ ۞ وَصَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا أَحْصَاهُ اللَّوْحُ الْمَحْفُوظُ مِنْ عِلْمِكَ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ‘alā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ‘alā āli sayyidinā Muḥammad ‘adada ‘ilmik, wa ṣalli ‘alā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ‘alā āli sayyidinā Muḥammad ‘adada ḥilmik, wa ṣalli ‘alā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ‘alā āli sayyidinā Muḥammad ‘adada mā aḥṣāhu al-lawḥu al-maḥfūẓu min ‘ilmik.
verses.en: O Allah bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad as much as Your knowledge. O Allah bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad as much as Your forbearance. our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad as much as Your knowledge is registered on the Preserved Tablets.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ ‖ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا جَرَى بِهِ الْقَلَمُ فِي أُمِّ الْكِتَابِ عِنْدَكَ ۞ وَصَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ مِّلْءَ سَمَاوَاتِكَ ۞ وَصَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ مِّلْءَ أَرْضِكَ ۞ وَصَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ مِّلْءَ مَا أَنْتَ خَالِقُهُ مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ‘alā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ‘alā āli sayyidinā Muḥammad ‘adada mā jarā bihi al-qalamu fī ummi al-kitābi ‘indak, wa ṣalli ‘alā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ‘alā āli sayyidinā Muḥammad mil’a samāwātik, wa ṣalli ‘alā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ‘alā āli sayyidinā Muḥammad mil’a arḍik, wa ṣalli ‘alā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ‘alā āli sayyidinā Muḥammad mil’a mā anta khāliquhu min yawmi khalaqta ad-dunyā ilā yawmi al-qiyāmah.
verses.en: O Allah bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad as much as the Pen has flowed in the mother of the Book lodged with You. And bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad to the fullness of Your Heavens. And bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad to the fullness of Your Earth. And bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad in all that You have created from the day You created this world until the Day of Resurrection.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ صُفُوفِ الْمَلَائِكَةِ وَتَسْبِيحِهِمْ وَتَقْدِيسِهِمْ، وَتَحْمِيدِهِمْ وَتَمْجِيدِهِمْ، وَتَكْبِيرِهِمْ وَتَهْلِيلِهِمْ، مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ‘alā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ‘alā āli sayyidinā Muḥammad ‘adada ṣufūfi al-malā’ikah wa tasbīḥihim wa taqdīsihim, wa taḥmīdihim wa tamjīdihim, wa takbīrihim wa tahlīlihim, min yawmi khalaqta ad-dunyā ilā yawmi al-qiyāmah.
verses.en: O Allah bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad as many times as the ranks of angels, their glorifications, their sanctifications, their praises, their magnifications, their declarations of the greatness and Your unity from the day You created this world until the Day of Resurrection.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ السَّحَابِ الْجَارِيَةِ، وَالرِّيَاحِ الذَّارِيَةِ، مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ‘alā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ‘alā āli sayyidinā Muḥammad ‘adada as-saḥābi al-jāriyah, war-riyāḥi adh-dhāriyah, min yawmi khalaqta ad-dunyā ilā yawmi al-qiyāmah.
verses.en: O Allah bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad in every rolling cloud and sweeping wind from the day You created this world until the Day of Resurrection.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ كُلِّ قَطْرَةٍ تَقْطُرُ مِنْ سَمَاوَاتِكَ إِلَى أَرْضِكَ، وَمَا تَقْطُرُ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ‘alā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ‘alā āli sayyidinā Muḥammad ‘adada kulli qaṭratin taqṭuru min samāwātika ilā arḍik, wa mā taqṭuru ilā yawmi al-qiyāmah.
verses.en: O Allah bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad in every drop of rain falling from Your heavens to Your earth and in all the rain that will fall until the Day of Resurrection.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ ‖ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا هَبَّتِ الرِّيَاحُ، وَعَدَدَ مَا تَحَرَّكَتِ الْأَشْجَارُ وَالْأَوْرَاقُ وَالزُّرُوعُ، وَجَمِيعِ مَا خَلَقْتَ فِي قَرَارِ الْحِفْظِ، مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ‘alā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ‘alā āli sayyidinā Muḥammad ‘adada mā habbat ar-riyāḥ, wa ‘adada mā taḥarrakat al-ashjāru wal-awrāqu waz-zurū‘, wa jamī‘i mā khalaqta fī qarāri al-ḥifẓ, min yawmi khalaqta ad-dunyā ilā yawmi al-qiyāmah.
verses.en: O Allah bless our master Muhammad in movement of every branch, every tree, every leaf and every plant stirred by the wind and in the wind-stirred movement of everything else that You have created in the Abode of Safety from the day You created the world to the Day of Resurrection.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ الْقَطْرِ وَالمَطَرِ وَالنَّبَاتِ، مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ‘alā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ‘alā āli sayyidinā Muḥammad ‘adada al-qaṭri wal-maṭari wan-nabāt, min yawmi khalaqta ad-dunyā ilā yawmi al-qiyāmah.
verses.en: O Allah bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad in every bead of dew, in every drop of rain and in every plant from the day You created the world to the Day of Resurrection.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ النُّجُومِ فِي السَّمَاءِ، مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ‘alā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ‘alā āli sayyidinā Muḥammad ‘adada an-nujūmi fī as-samā’, min yawmi khalaqta ad-dunyā ilā yawmi al-qiyāmah.
verses.en: O Allah bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad in every star in the sky from the day You created this world until the Day or Resurrection.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا خَلَقْتَ فِي بِحَارِكَ السَّبْعَةِ مِمَّا لَا يَعْلَمُ عِلْمَهُ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، وَمَا أَنْتَ خَالِقُهُ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ‘alā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ‘alā āli sayyidinā Muḥammad ‘adada mā khalaqta fī biḥārika as-sab‘ah mimmā lā ya‘lamu ‘ilmahu illā anta, wa mā anta khāliquhu ilā yawmi al-qiyāmah.
verses.en: O Allah bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad as much as You have created in Your Seven Seas, knowledge of which is Yours alone, and as much as that which You will create until the Day of Resurrection.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ الرَّمْلِ وَالحَصَى، فِي مَشَارِقِ الْأَرْضِ وَمَغَارِبِهَا
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ‘alā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ‘alā āli sayyidinā Muḥammad ‘adada ar-ramli wal-ḥaṣā fī mashāriqi al-arḍi wa maghāribihā.
verses.en: O Allah bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad in every grain of sand and in every pebble on the earth, East and West.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا خَلَقْتَ مِنَ الْجِنِّ ‖ وَالْإِنْسِ، وَمَا أَنْتَ خَالِقُهُ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ‘alā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ‘alā āli sayyidinā Muḥammad ‘adada mā khalaqta mina al-jinni wal-insi, wa mā anta khāliquhu ilā yawmi al-qiyāmah.
verses.en: O Allah bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad in every jinn and human being You have created and in one them that You will create until the Day of Resurrection.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ أَنْفَاسِهِمْ وَأَلْفَاظِهِمْ وَأَلْحَاظِهِمْ مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ‘alā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ‘alā āli sayyidinā Muḥammad ‘adada anfāsihim wa alfāẓihim wa alḥāẓihim, min yawmi khalaqta ad-dunyā ilā yawmi al-qiyāmah.
verses.en: O Allah bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad in every one of their breaths, their utterances and their glances from the day You created this until the Day of Resurrection.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ طَيْرَانِ الْجِنِّ وَالمَلَائِكَةِ، مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ‘alā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ‘alā āli sayyidinā Muḥammad ‘adada ṭayarāni al-jinni wal-malā’ikati, min yawmi khalaqta ad-dunyā ilā yawmi al-qiyāmah.
verses.en: O Allah bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad in the flying of the jinn and the angels from the day You created this world until the Day of Resurrection

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ الطُّيُورِ وَالهَوَامِّ، وَعَدَدَ الْوُحُوشِ وَالْآكَامِ فِي مَشَارِقِ الْأَرْضِ وَمَغَارِبِهَا
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ‘alā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ‘alā āli sayyidinā Muḥammad ‘adada aṭ-ṭuyūri wal-hawāmmi, wa ‘adada al-wuḥūshi wal-ākām fī mashāriqi al-arḍi wa maghāribihā.
verses.en: O Allah bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad in every bird and pest in every wild beast and in every hill on the earth, East and West.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ الْأَحْيَاءِ وَالأَمْوَاتِ ۞ اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا أَظْلَمَ عَلَيْهِ اللَّيْلُ وَأَشْرَقَ عَلَيْهِ النَّهَارُ، مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ‘alā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ‘alā āli sayyidinā Muḥammad ‘adada al-aḥyā’i wal-amwāt. Allāhumma ṣalli ‘alā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ‘alā āli sayyidinā Muḥammad ‘adada mā aẓlama ‘alayhi al-laylu wa ashrāqa ‘alayhi an-nahār, min yawmi khalaqta ad-dunyā ilā yawmi al-qiyāmah
verses.en: O Allah bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad equal in number to the living and the dead. O Allah bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad as much as all the night has covered in darkness and all the day has illuminated from the day You created this world until the Day of Resurrection.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَنْ يَمْشِي عَلٰى رِجْلَيْنِ، وَمَنْ يَمْشِي عَلٰى أَرْبَعٍ، مِنْ يَوْمِ ‖ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ‘alā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ‘alā āli sayyidinā Muḥammad ‘adada man yamshī ‘alā rijlayn, wa man yamshī ‘alā arba‘, min yawmi khalaqta ad-dunyā ilā yawmi al-qiyāmah.
verses.en: O Allah bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad equal in number to all who walk on two legs and all who walk on four, from the day You created this world until the Day of Resurrection.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَنْ صَلَّى عَلَيْهِ مِنَ الْجِنِّ وَالإِنْسِ وَالمَلَائِكَةِ، مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ‘alā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ‘alā āli sayyidinā Muḥammad ‘adada man ṣallā ‘alayhi mina al-jinni wal-insi wal-malā’ikati, min yawmi khalaqta ad-dunyā ilā yawmi al-qiyāmah.
verses.en: O Allah bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad as many times as the jinn, the human beings and the angels have asked You to bless him from the day You created this world until the Day of Resurrection.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَنْ لَمْ يُصَلِّ عَلَيْهِ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ‘alā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ‘alā āli sayyidinā Muḥammad ‘adada man lam yuṣalli ‘alayh.
verses.en: O Allah bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad as many times as those who have not asked for blessings upon him.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا يَجِبُ أَنْ يُّصَلَّى عَلَيْهِ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ‘alā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ‘alā āli sayyidinā Muḥammad kamā yajibu an yuṣallā ‘alayh.
verses.en: O Allah bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad as it is incumbent upon us to ask You to bless him.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا يَنْبَغِي أَنْ يُصَلَّى عَلَيْهِ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ‘alā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ‘alā āli sayyidinā Muḥammad kamā yanbaghī an yuṣallā ‘alayh.
verses.en: O Allah bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad as it is fitting for him to be blessed.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ حَتَّى لَا يَبْقَى شَيْءٌ مِنَ الصَّلَاةِ عَلَيْهِ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ‘alā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ‘alā āli sayyidinā Muḥammad ḥattā lā yabqā shay’un mina aṣ-ṣalāti ‘alayh.
verses.en: O Allah bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad until all blessings are exhausted.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ فِي الْأَوَّلِينَ ۞ وَصَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ فِي الْآخِرِينَ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ‘alā sayyidinā Muḥammadin fī al-awwalīn, wa ṣalli ‘alā sayyidinā Muḥammadin fī al-ākhirīn.
verses.en: O Allah bless our master Muhammad among the first. And bless our master Muhammad among the last.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ فِي الْمَلَا الْأَعْلَى إِلَى يَوْمِ الدِّينِ ۞ مَا شَاءَ اللّٰهُ، لَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللّٰهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli ‘alā sayyidinā Muḥammadin fī al-malā’i al-a‘lā ilā yawmi ad-dīn, mā shā’a Allāh, lā quwwata illā billāh al-‘aliyy al-‘aẓīm.
verses.en: O Allah bless our master Muhammad in the heavenly Assembly until the Day of Reckoning. And what Allah wills. There is no power except through Allah, the High the Great.
